description: First expansion: flash, storage, digital audio and debug. Manual AI expectations are not measured by retrieval checks.

cases.prompt: QSPI and OSPI overview: select memory protocol and boot behavior
cases.ai_expectation: QSPI and OSPI are not interchangeable capabilities; consult errata and exact device guides.
ST example dimensions are not universal limits for other controllers or packages.
No universal DQS length tolerance or register value is supplied. HyperBus and regular-command protocols need separate configuration.

cases.prompt: SD SDIO and eMMC overview: establish mode and voltage
cases.ai_expectation: SD memory, SDIO peripherals and eMMC are not interchangeable; this overview is not an HS200/HS400 specification.

cases.prompt: Removable SD card and SDIO routing review
cases.ai_expectation: OMAP44xx resistor and ramp-time examples must not become universal rules. SDIO devices may need additional enable or interrupt signals.
Detailed HS200/HS400 strobe routing is not covered. Obtain the selected SoC and memory design guides before setting high-speed geometry.

cases.prompt: I2S TDM and PDM overview: establish format and clock ownership
cases.ai_expectation: Do not assume identical pin labels imply compatible framing or that every I2S receiver accepts PDM.

cases.prompt: I2S and TDM clock and data routing pattern
cases.ai_expectation: Device-specific unused-pin and stereo-chain instructions are not general I2S rules.

cases.prompt: PDM microphone clock and data pattern
cases.ai_expectation: Shared data wiring requires compatible output-enable timing; do not parallel arbitrary microphone outputs.

cases.prompt: JTAG and SWD overview: preserve debug access and reset states
cases.ai_expectation: Internal pull resistors differ by device; do not apply STM32F4 defaults to every target.
VTref is a sense/reference input on the cited J-Link connector, not an assumed target-power output.
An unpowered or misconfigured target can prevent chain access. SWD is not wired as a JTAG serial chain.
